vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: rpe-grafana
Version: 1.0.2

The rpe-grafana skill is a legitimate tool for retrieving metrics from Grafana dashboards. It implements tools to list dashboards, list panels, and execute pre-defined queries associated with specific panels using the standard Grafana API (/api/ds/query). The implementation includes security-conscious design choices, such as only executing queries already defined within a dashboard rather than allowing arbitrary query injection, and it correctly uses URI encoding for parameters in index.js.
